overview.headline: Secret convention that drafted a new American government

keyPoints.point: delegates worked in secret during the summer to draft a new frame of government
keyPoints.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787

keyPoints.point: delegates convened in Philadelphia to revise the Articles of Confederation
keyPoints.quote: convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787

keyPoints.point: discussion made clear the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government
keyPoints.quote: the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government

keyPoints.point: central power and representation and election methods were chief points at issue
keyPoints.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government

keyTerms.gloss: delegates who met in secret to draft the new government frame
keyTerms.quote: Drafted in secret by delegates to the Constitutional Convention during the summer of 1787

keyTerms.gloss: existing plan of government that the Convention first met to revise
keyTerms.quote: to revise the Articles of Confederation

keyTerms.gloss: minimum number of states needed to conduct convention business
keyTerms.quote: until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25

keyTerms.gloss: national authority whose power was a chief point of debate
keyTerms.quote: how much power to allow the central government
